summary: Audit of 'AI-Driven Requirement Engineering Assistant1.pdf' (Project Name- AI-Driven Requirement Engineering Assistant): Extracted 2073 words across 171 requirement statements. The document establishes functional scope but requires formal NFR definitions, API schema contracts, and security hardening.

risk_factors.title: High Ambiguity & Untestable Language (Project Name- AI-Driven Requirement Engineering Assistant)
risk_factors.description: Specification contains subjective and untestable phrasing including 'fast'. Engineering teams cannot derive deterministic acceptance tests.
risk_factors.mitigation: Rewrite requirements into verifiable Gherkin syntax (Given/When/Then) with quantifiable metrics (e.g. latency, error rates).

risk_factors.title: Payment Processing & PCI-DSS Compliance Gap
risk_factors.description: Document mentions financial transactions or payments without defining PCI-DSS tokenization, webhook verification, or idempotent charge safety.
risk_factors.mitigation: Integrate certified payment gateway with client-side tokenization (e.g., Stripe Elements) and zero plain-text card data retention.

conflicts_and_ambiguities.context: Document text contains ambiguous phrase 'fast' without technical boundaries or SLA targets.
conflicts_and_ambiguities.suggested_resolution: Replace 'fast' with objective, measurable performance constraints or automated QA acceptance criteria.

missing_sections_and_details.why_missing: Missing latency thresholds (P95 < 200ms), concurrent user targets, and database connection limits.
missing_sections_and_details.recommended_addition: Define target throughput (e.g. 500 RPS), 99.9% uptime SLA, and disaster recovery RTO/RPO.

missing_sections_and_details.why_missing: Data models, foreign key relationships, and migration strategies are unaddressed.
missing_sections_and_details.recommended_addition: Provide entity relationship diagrams (ERD) and JSON schema validation rules.
